propositions: the reconciler must be proven to move data bidirectionally against a live Jira Data Center instance over a realistic copy of this project's actual ticket store, not an empty one

the testing store must be isolated from production remotes by creating a separate repo with no git remotes and copying ticket content via git archive from the orphan tickets branch into .tickets-tracker/
the store copy must be scrubbed of all .bridge_state* artifacts and production Jira bindings to prevent accidental writes to live issues
each of 28 mutations (14 inbound + 14 outbound) must be individually asserted to round-trip against verified oracles, never by aggregate converged counts
pagination must be proven by seeding 2*observed_page_size+1 issues in the harness and confirming all are recovered, not assumed
